content.name: write
content.arguments:
{"content": """"导出当前（或指定）DSH 会话的完整上下文

用法：
    python export_chat.py                 # 导出当前会话
    python export_chat.py --full          # 工具输出不截断
    python export_chat.py --max-chars 8000
    python export_chat.py --session session-xxxx

产物（exports/chat-<短id>/）：
    session.jsonl     原始事件流（逐行 JSON，最完整）
    conversation.md   可读对话稿（用户/助手/工具调用/工具结果/交付物）
    manifest.json     统计信息
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import time
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from compression import zstd

WORKSPACE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def find_session_file(session_id: str) -> Path:
    base = Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"]) / ".dsh" / "sessions"
    matches = list(base.glob(f"*/*{session_id}*/session.v4.jsonl.zstd"))
    if not matches:
        raise SystemExit(f"找不到会话文件：{session_id}")
    return max(matches, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)


def ts(ms: int | None) -> str:
    if not ms:
        return "?"
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def blocks_to_text(content, max_chars: int | None) -> str:
    """把 message.content 转成文本；超长时截断并标注。"""
    parts = []
    for block in content or []:
        if not isinstance(block, dict):
            parts.append(str(block))
            continue
        kind = block.get("type")
        if kind in ("text", "reasoning"):
            parts.append(block.get("text", ""))
        elif kind == "image":
            att = block.get("attachment") or block.get("path") or block.get("id")
            parts.append(f"[图片：{att}]")
        elif kind == "tool-call":
            continue                      # 由 tool/call 事件单独记录
        else:
            parts.append(f"[{kind}] " + json.dumps(block, ensure_ascii=False)[:300])
    text = "\n\n".join(p for p in parts if p)
    if max_chars and len(text) > max_chars:
        text = text[:max_chars] + f"\n\n…[已截断，原长 {len(text)} 字符；完整内容见 session.jsonl]"
    return text


def reasoning_of(content) -> str:
    return "\n\n".join(b.get("text", "") for b in content or []
                       if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "reasoning")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="导出 DSH 会话上下文")
    ap.add_argument("--session", default=os.environ.get("DSH_SESSION_ID"))
    ap.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="工具输出不截断")
    ap.add_argument("--max-chars", type=int, default=4000,
                    help="工具结果/参数的最大字符数（--full 时忽略）")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    max_chars = None if args.full else args.max_chars

    if not args.session:
        raise SystemExit("没有 DSH_SESSION_ID，请用 --session 指定")

    src = find_session_file(args.session)
    raw = zstd.decompress(src.read_bytes())
    lines = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()

    out_dir = WORKSPACE / "exports" / f"chat-{args.session[-8:]}"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out_dir / "session.jsonl").write_bytes(raw)

    out = []
    stats = Counter()
    tool_names = Counter()
    title = ""
    turn = 0
    first_time = last_time = None

    def add(line: str = "") -> None:
        out.append(line)

    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            ev = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            add(f"\n> ⚠️ 无法解析的事件行：`{line[:120]}…`\n")
            continue

        etype = ev.get("type", "?")
        data = ev.get("data") or {}
        t = ev.get("time") or data.get("time")
        if t:
            first_time = first_time or t
            last_time = t

        if etype == "session":
            title = data.get("title") or ""
            add(f"# 会话导出：{args.session}\n")
            add(f"- 工作目录：`{ev.get('cwd', '')}`")
            add(f"- 创建时间：{ts(ev.get('createdAt'))}")
            add(f"- 源文件：`{src}`")
            add(f"- 事件数：{len(lines)}")
            add("")
            add("---\n")
            stats["session"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "session/title":
            title = data.get("title") or title
            continue

        if etype == "turn/start":
            turn = data.get("turn", turn + 1)
            add(f"\n## 第 {turn} 轮 · {ts(t)}\n")
            stats["turns"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "user/message":
            text = blocks_to_text((data.get("content") or []), max_chars)
            add(f"\n### 👤 用户 · {ts(t)}\n")
            add(text)
            add("")
            stats["user_messages"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "assistant/message":
            msg = data.get("message") or {}
            content = msg.get("content") or []
            text = blocks_to_text([b for b in content
                                   if not (isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "reasoning")],
                                  max_chars)
            reason = reasoning_of(content)
            if text:
                add(f"\n### 🤖 助手 · {ts(t)}\n")
                add(text)
                add("")
            if reason:
                add("<details><summary>思考过程</summary>\n")
                add(reason[:max_chars] if max_chars else reason)
                add("\n</details>\n")
            stats["assistant_messages"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "tool/call":
            name = data.get("name", "?")
            args_text = data.get("arguments") or ""
            try:
                args_text = json.dumps(json.loads(args_text), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if max_chars and len(args_text) > max_chars:
                args_text = args_text[:max_chars] + f"\n…[参数已截断，原长 {len(args_text)} 字符]"
            add(f"\n#### 🔧 调用工具 `{name}` · {ts(t)}\n")
            add("```json\n" + args_text + "\n```\n")
            stats["tool_calls"] += 1
            tool_names[name] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "tool/result":
            msg = data.get("message") or {}
            text = blocks_to_text(msg.get("content") or [], max_chars)
            add(f"\n#### 📤 工具结果 · {ts(t)}\n")
            add("```text\n" + text + "\n```\n")
            stats["tool_results"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "deliverables/presented":
            add(f"\n#### 📦 交付物 · {ts(t)}\n")
            for f in data.get("files") or []:
                add(f"- `{f.get('path')}` — {f.get('description', '')}")
            add("")
            stats["deliverables"] += 1
            continue

        if etype in ("approval/asked", "approval/decided"):
            add(f"\n> 🔐 审批事件（{etype}）· {ts(t)}：`{json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)[:300]}`\n")
            stats["approvals"] += 1
            continue

        # 其余事件（step/start、job/*、workspace/changes…）保留在 session.jsonl，不写入可读稿
        stats["skipped"] += 1

    md = "\n".join(out)
    (out_dir / "conversation.md").write_text(md, encoding="utf-8")

    manifest = {
        "session_id": args.session,
        "source": str(src),
        "title": title,
        "exported_at": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "time_range": [ts(first_time), ts(last_time)],
        "events": len(lines),
        "decompressed_bytes": len(raw),
        "stats": dict(stats),
        "tool_calls_by_name": dict(tool_names.most_common()),
        "files": {
            "session.jsonl": (out_dir / "session.jsonl").stat().st_size,
            "conversation.md": (out_dir / "conversation.md").stat().st_size,
        },
    }
    (out_dir / "manifest.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"导出完成：{out_dir}")
    print(f"  事件 {len(lines)} 条，解压后 {len(raw) / 1024:.0f} KB")
    print(f"  对话稿 {manifest['files']['conversation.md'] / 1024:.0f} KB，"
          f"原始流 {manifest['files']['session.jsonl'] / 1024:.0f} KB")
    print(f"  轮次 {stats['turns']}｜用户 {stats['user_messages']}｜助手 {stats['assistant_messages']}"
          f"｜工具调用 {stats['tool_calls']}｜交付 {stats['deliverables']}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#### 🔧 调用工具 `write` · 2026-10-30 00:18:35

```json
{
  "content": """"导出当前（或指定）DSH 会话的完整上下文

用法：
    python export_chat.py                 # 导出当前会话
    python export_chat.py --full          # 工具输出不截断
    python export_chat.py --max-chars 8000
    python export_chat.py --session session-xxxx

产物（exports/chat-<短id>/）：
    session.jsonl     原始事件流（逐行 JSON，最完整）
    conversation.md   可读对话稿（用户/助手/工具调用/工具结果/交付物）
    manifest.json     统计信息
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import time
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from compression import zstd

WORKSPACE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def find_session_file(session_id: str) -> Path:
    base = Path(os.environ["USERPROFILE"]) / ".dsh" / "sessions"
    matches = list(base.glob(f"*/*{session_id}*/session.v4.jsonl.zstd"))
    if not matches:
        raise SystemExit(f"找不到会话文件：{session_id}")
    return max(matches, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)


def ts(ms: int | None) -> str:
    if not ms:
        return "?"
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def blocks_to_text(content, max_chars: int | None) -> str:
    """把 message.content 转成文本；超长时截断并标注。"""
    parts = []
    for block in content or []:
        if not isinstance(block, dict):
            parts.append(str(block))
            continue
        kind = block.get("type")
        if kind in ("text", "reasoning"):
            parts.append(block.get("text", ""))
        elif kind == "image":
            att = block.get("attachment") or block.get("path") or block.get("id")
            parts.append(f"[图片：{att}]")
        elif kind == "tool-call":
            continue                      # 由 tool/call 事件单独记录
        else:
            parts.append(f"[{kind}] " + json.dumps(block, ensure_ascii=False)[:300])
    text = "\n\n".join(p for p in parts if p)
    if max_chars and len(text) > max_chars:
        text = text[:max_chars] + f"\n\n…[已截断，原长 {len(text)} 字符；完整内容见 session.jsonl]"
    return text


def reasoning_of(content) -> str:
    return "\n\n".join(b.get("text", "") for b in content or []
                       if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "reasoning")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="导出 DSH 会话上下文")
    ap.add_argument("--session", default=os.environ.get("DSH_SESSION_ID"))
    ap.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="工具输出不截断")
    ap.add_argument("--max-chars", type=int, default=4000,
                    help="工具结果/参数的最大字符数（--full 时忽略）")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    max_chars = None if args.full else args.max_chars

    if not args.session:
        raise SystemExit("没有 DSH_SESSION_ID，请用 --session 指定")

    src = find_session_file(args.session)
    raw = zstd.decompress(src.read_bytes())
    lines = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()

    out_dir = WORKSPACE / "exports" / f"chat-{args.session[-8:]}"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out_dir / "session.jsonl").write_bytes(raw)

    out = []
    stats = Counter()
    tool_names = Counter()
    title = ""
    turn = 0
    first_time = last_time = None

    def add(line: str = "") -> None:
        out.append(line)

    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            ev = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            add(f"\n> ⚠️ 无法解析的事件行：`{line[:120]}…`\n")
            continue

        etype = ev.get("type", "?")
        data = ev.get("data") or {}
        t = ev.get("time") or data.get("time")
        if t:
            first_time = first_time or t
            last_time = t

        if etype == "session":
            title = data.get("title") or ""
            add(f"# 会话导出：{args.session}\n")
            add(f"- 工作目录：`{ev.get('cwd', '')}`")
            add(f"- 创建时间：{ts(ev.get('createdAt'))}")
            add(f"- 源文件：`{src}`")
            add(f"- 事件数：{len(lines)}")
            add("")
            add("---\n")
            stats["session"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "session/title":
            title = data.get("title") or title
            continue

        if etype == "turn/start":
            turn = data.get("turn", turn + 1)
            add(f"\n## 第 {turn} 轮 · {ts(t)}\n")
            stats["turns"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "user/message":
            text = blocks_to_text((data.get("content") or []), max_chars)
            add(f"\n### 👤 用户 · {ts(t)}\n")
            add(text)
            add("")
            stats["user_messages"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "assistant/message":
            msg = data.get("message") or {}
            content = msg.get("content") or []
            text = blocks_to_text([b for b in content
                                   if not (isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "reasoning")],
                                  max_chars)
            reason = reasoning_of(content)
            if text:
                add(f"\n### 🤖 助手 · {ts(t)}\n")
                add(text)
                add("")
            if reason:
                add("<details><summary>思考过程</summary>\n")
                add(reason[:max_chars] if max_chars else reason)
                add("\n</details>\n")
            stats["assistant_messages"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "tool/call":
            name = data.get("name", "?")
            args_text = data.get("arguments") or ""
            try:
                args_text = json.dumps(json.loads(args_text), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            except Exception:
                pass
            if max_chars and len(args_text) > max_chars:
                args_text = args_text[:max_chars] + f"\n…[参数已截断，原长 {len(args_text)} 字符]"
            add(f"\n#### 🔧 调用工具 `{name}` · {ts(t)}\n")
            add("```json\n" + args_text + "\n```\n")
            stats["tool_calls"] += 1
            tool_names[name] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "tool/result":
            msg = data.get("message") or {}
            text = blocks_to_text(msg.get("content") or [], max_chars)
            add(f"\n#### 📤 工具结果 · {ts(t)}\n")
            add("```text\n" + text + "\n```\n")
            stats["tool_results"] += 1
            continue

        if etype == "deliverables/presented":
            add(f"\n#### 📦 交付物 · {ts(t)}\n")
            for f in data.get("files") or []:
                add(f"- `{f.get('path')}` — {f.get('description', '')}")
            add("")
            stats["deliverables"] += 1
            continue

        if etype in ("approval/asked", "approval/decided"):
            add(f"\n> 🔐 审批事件（{etype}）· {ts(t)}：`{json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)[:300]}`\n")
            stats["approvals"] += 1
            continue

        # 其余事件（step/start、job/*、workspace/changes…）保留在 session.jsonl，不写入可读稿
        stats["skipped"] += 1

    md = "\n".join(out)
    (out_dir / "conversation.md").write_text(md, encoding="utf-8")

    manifest = {
        "session_id": args.session,
        "source": str(src),
        "title": title,
        "exported_at": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "time_range": [ts(first_time), ts(last_time)],
        "events": len(lines),
        "decompressed_bytes": len(raw),
        "stats": dict(stats),
        "tool_calls_by_name": dict(tool_names.most_common()),
        "files": {
            "session.jsonl": (out_dir / "session.jsonl").stat().st_size,
            "conversation.md": (out_dir / "conversation.md").stat().st_size,
        },
    }
    (out_dir / "manifest.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"导出完成：{out_dir}")
    print(f"  事件 {len(lines)} 条，解压后 {len(raw) / 1024:.0f} KB")
    print(f"  对话稿 {manifest['files']['conversation.md'] / 1024:.0f} KB，"
          f"原始流 {manifest['files']['session.jsonl'] / 1024:.0f} KB")
    print(f"  轮次 {stats['turns']}｜用户 {stats['user_messages']}｜助手 {stats['assistant_messages']}"
          f"｜工具调用 {stats['tool_calls']}｜交付 {stats['deliverables']}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```
